project.title: Bacterial Community characteristics in marine bioaerosols on the Bohai Sea, Yellow Sea and Northwest Pacific in spring
project.description: The diversity and composition of bacterial community in marine bioaerosols on the Bohai Sea, Yellow Sea and Northwest Pacific in spring was investigated based on the high-throughput sequencing analyses of the 16S rRNA gene
